title: Recap: Recommending a Place with érdemes

sections.title: Recommending sights and cultural visits
sections.content: You know *érdemes* + infinitive from A2 Unit 18 (*érdemes meglátogatni* = it is worth visiting) and *ha* + the -hat/-het form from A2 Unit 23 (*ha teheted* = if you can). Use them to recommend a place: *Ha Egerben jársz, mindenképpen érdemes meglátogatni a várat.*

items.spanish: Ha Egerben jársz, mindenképpen érdemes meglátogatni a várat.
items.english: If you are in Eger, it is definitely worth visiting the castle.
If you can, go to Szeged.

items.spanish: A Balatonnál érdemes sétálni a parton.
items.english: At Lake Balaton it is worth walking on the shore.
